SELECT repairPart.* , repairOrder.order_no AS orderNo , part.part_name AS partName , part.sale_price AS salePrice FROM repair_part repairPart LEFT JOIN repair_order repairOrder ON repairPart.repair_order_id = repairOrder.id LEFT JOIN part part ON repairPart.part_id = part.id
ORDER BY repairPart.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
